answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 28777 Country: India Title: Which is better applying mehndi on hairs or leaving white colour hairs as it is? Question: Assalaamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullaahi wa Barakatuhu! Respected pious scholar,Which is better applying mehndi on hairs or leaving white colour hairs as it is?JAZAKALLAH KHARIAN! Answer ID: 28777 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 95/95/M=1432) It is better to apply the dye of red henna in white hair. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
